title: 隧道管棚超前支護
summary: 本課以用縱向跨距、搭接與鑽孔幾何檢核管棚超前支護為主線，從縱向橋接與反力路徑與鋼管截面與抗彎剛度建立系統邊界，再把鑽孔傾角與端部偏位、地層彈簧與支承剛度連到支護界面與撤除判斷。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on check pipe umbrellas through longitudinal spans, overlap and bore geometry. It begins with Longitudinal bridging and reactions and Pipe section and flexural stiffness, links Bore inclination and end offset and Ground springs and restraint stiffness, and ends with Support interfaces and transfer decisions. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查縱向橋接與反力路徑：M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm；再獨立檢查鋼管截面與抗彎剛度：Inputs D,d in m; I=pi*(D^4-d^4)/64=pi*(0.114^4-0.102^4)/64=2.98e-6 m4。理想簡支跨度由 3.0 增為 3.3 m，均布線荷載 30 kN/m 不變，彎矩由 33.75 增為 40.84 kNm，增加 21%；連續地層支承仍須另建模。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 將以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Longitudinal bridging and reactions: M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm. Independently check Pipe section and flexural stiffness: Inputs D,d in m; I=pi*(D^4-d^4)/64=pi*(0.114^4-0.102^4)/64=2.98e-6 m4. At fixed 30 kN/m, increasing an ideal simple span from 3.0 to 3.3 m raises moment from 33.75 to 40.84 kNm, by 21%; continuous ground restraint requires a separate model. The two results are not a complete design because the umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. Use correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縱向橋接與反力路徑」與「鋼管截面與抗彎剛度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Longitudinal bridging and reactions" and "Pipe section and flexural stiffness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal bridging and reactions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「縱向橋接與反力路徑」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管棚把開挖前方部分荷載跨越未支護區傳給後方初支和前方地層。反力不是固定鉸支點，會隨地層鬆動及支護沉陷移動；簡支梁可用來理解跨距平方的敏感度，但不能隱去土管接觸和開挖循環的影響。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時；若出現後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「縱向橋接與反力路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An umbrella bridges an unsupported zone and transfers load to previous support and ground ahead. Reactions move as ground loosens and support settles rather than acting as fixed hinges. A simple beam reveals squared-span sensitivity but does not capture contact changes and excavation cycles. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance. If rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently long umbrella does not require reactions from rear support" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「縱向橋接與反力路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Longitudinal bridging and reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

options: 管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力

steps.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal bridging and reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縱向橋接與反力路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal bridging and reactions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「縱向橋接與反力路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.text: 將把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

optionsEn: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Unchanged sensor readings prove that the umbrella position has not moved
quiz.explanation: 把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal bridging and reactions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「縱向橋接與反力路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時；若出現後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 開孔間距與拱頂連續性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pipe spacing and crown continuity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開孔間距與拱頂連續性」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pipe spacing and crown continuity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管棚是離散管件，管間土體需要自身拱效應或其他改良才能把荷載傳到管上。間距以孔口量到不代表遠端仍相同，鑽孔發散會產生局部大空隙；評估應檢查最不利遠端幾何而非只看環向平均間距。 判別這個機制時，應觀察重建孔口及遠端位置，沿長度比較相鄰管件淨距；若出現孔口排列整齊但遠端發散，局部土體從管間鬆落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開孔間距與拱頂連續性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An umbrella consists of discrete pipes; intervening ground needs arching or treatment to deliver load to them. If orderly collars conceal distal divergence and local ground falls between pipes, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pipe spacing and crown continuity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開孔間距與拱頂連續性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pipe spacing and crown continuity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：gap=centreSpacing-outsideDiameter=0.35 m-0.114 m=0.236 m。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: gap=centreSpacing-outsideDiameter=0.35 m-0.114 m=0.236 m. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重建孔口及遠端位置，沿長度比較相鄰管件淨距。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 開孔間距與拱頂連續性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pipe spacing and crown continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開孔間距與拱頂連續性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pipe spacing and crown continuity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重建孔口及遠端位置，沿長度比較相鄰管件淨距。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「孔口排列整齊但遠端發散，局部土體從管間鬆落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct collar and distal positions and compare pipe clear gaps along their length. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Orderly collars conceal distal divergence and local ground falls between pipes. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將重建孔口及遠端位置，沿長度比較相鄰管件淨距列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現孔口排列整齊但遠端發散，局部土體從管間鬆落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconstruct collar and distal positions and compare pipe clear gaps along their length. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If orderly collars conceal distal divergence and local ground falls between pipes, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔口排列整齊但遠端發散，局部土體從管間鬆落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Orderly collars conceal distal divergence and local ground falls between pipes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.title: 開孔間距與拱頂連續性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pipe spacing and crown continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開孔間距與拱頂連續性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pipe spacing and crown continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔口排列整齊但遠端發散，局部土體從管間鬆落。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到重建孔口及遠端位置，沿長度比較相鄰管件淨距，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察重建孔口及遠端位置，沿長度比較相鄰管件淨距；若出現孔口排列整齊但遠端發散，局部土體從管間鬆落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing collar spacing proves continuity throughout the umbrella length" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 搭接長度與施工循環：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Overlap and excavation cycles: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「搭接長度與施工循環」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overlap and excavation cycles” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰兩輪管棚的搭接維持縱向傳力，但有效搭接還受鑽孔偏差、端部品質和前一輪變形影響。總長減進尺只是名義值，不能保證搭接區同時具備地層反力；各循環應把初支位置與下一輪孔口連在同一里程帳。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將各輪實際進尺、孔長及初支末端位置逐段核對；若出現累積超進尺吃掉搭接，造成兩輪之間的局部弱帶，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「搭接長度與施工循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overlap maintains transfer between successive umbrellas, but effective overlap depends on deviation, end quality and previous deformation. Length minus advance is nominal geometry rather than proof of ground reaction. Link support position and the next collar in a common chainage record for every cycle. knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A one-degree error can always be ignored in a long umbrella Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bore inclination and end offset" is correct?
options: 一度角度誤差在長管棚中永遠可以忽略
實際注量越大就一定代表管周填充越完整
微小角度偏差在長孔末端會形成顯著位移，角度與坡度百分比混用更會造成系統錯誤。
optionsEn: A one-degree error can always be ignored in a long umbrella
Greater delivered grout volume always means more complete annular filling
Small angular errors create substantial distal offsets, while confusing angle with percent grade creates systematic bias.
quiz.explanation: 微小角度偏差在長孔末端會形成顯著位移，角度與坡度百分比混用更會造成系統錯誤。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small angular errors create substantial distal offsets, while confusing angle with percent grade creates systematic bias. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 接頭轉角與局部弱段：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「接頭轉角與局部弱段」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 管件接頭的彎曲剛度可能小於連續鋼管，轉角會集中在螺紋或套管附近。用完整截面慣性矩跨過接頭可能低估位移，注漿後也不必然恢復母材連續性；應把接頭位置和最大彎矩區域一起檢查，避免薄弱段重疊。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測接頭兩側相對轉角並記錄接頭所處支承區段；若出現接頭落在最大彎曲區產生集中轉角並破壞周邊接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭轉角與局部弱段」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connections can be more flexible than continuous pipe, concentrating rotation near threads or sleeves. Extending parent-section inertia through a joint can underpredict movement, and grouting need not restore full continuity. Compare connection positions with high-moment regions to identify coincident weaknesses. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure relative rotation across joints and record their supporting ground zones. If a joint in the peak-bending zone concentrates rotation and damages surrounding contact, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint rotation and local weak segments” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: An umbrella belongs to a staged system whose load is progressively shared with initial support and a closed ring. Adding lining to a model does not erase existing pipe force. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.title: 支護界面與撤除判斷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support interfaces and transfer decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護界面與撤除判斷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support interfaces and transfer decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查；若出現新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新襯砌完成外觀就代表管棚全部荷載已轉移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A completed lining appearance proves every umbrella load has transferred" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
